test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

RETORT
solution:
The correct answer is '**Reply**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Retort**' is '**Reply**'.
 
• **Retort**: to reply quickly to what somebody says, in an angry or amusing way. [किसी की बात का तुरंत जवाब देना (चिढ़कर या विनोदी ढंग से)]
 
 
• *Example: ‘Who asked you for your opinion?’ she **retorted**.*
 
 
 
• **Reply**: to say, write or do something as an answer to somebody/something. (जवाब या उत्तर के रूप में किसी को कुछ कहना, लिखना या कुछ करना)
 
 
• *Example: I wrote to Shalini but she hasn’t **replied**.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Reply.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Advise**: to tell somebody what you think he/she should do. सलाह या सुझाव देना
 
• **Request**: an act of asking for something. (किसी बात के लिए) अनुरोध या निवेदन; प्रार्थना
 
• **Question**: a sentence or phrase that asks for an answer. (किसी विषय में) प्रश्‍न, सवाल (किसी बात का उत्तर पाने के लिए प्रयुक्त वाक्‍य या वाक्‍यांश)
